title: Password-reset requirement authoring
objective: Turn an ambiguous product brief into a reviewable requirement and verification outline.
brief: A user can request a password-reset link by email.
The link must be secure and should expire.
Support must be able to explain rejected reset attempts.

baseline: Write ordinary Markdown using the team's usual headings.
Record dependencies and tests in prose.
bitz: Write a REQ with valid Frontmatter and EARS-AI statements.
Declare typed relations and test coverage paths explicitly.

completionCriteria: Expiry, one-time use, account-enumeration resistance, and auditable rejection are unambiguous.
Each mandatory behavior has a verification approach.
